verdict.rationale: The API supports searching for and retrieving MailItems, which implies a mechanism to pull scans and metadata out of the platform programmatically, but there is no documented bulk-export feature, no export-all/download-archive tool, and no mention of exporting mail history in bulk. Missing for 10: explicit bulk-export endpoint or dashboard feature, confirmation that PDF files (not just metadata) can be retrieved via API, and independent/hands-on evidence of a bulk export working.
